name: detectai-web (${environment})
description: Next.js frontend + BFF: routes, dependencies, auth, checkout. service.name = web.

pages.name: Web service
pages.description: RED per route plus downstream dependency health

rawConfiguration.text:
## Web (`service.name = web`, env `${environment}`)
Next.js SSR + API routes. **Dependency map:** `AI_SERVICE_URL`, `CHAT_SERVICE_URL`, `FILE_EXTRACTOR_API_URL`, PG pool (`DB_POOL_MAX`), users-Redis. Auth: NextAuth GitHub/Google + Turnstile. Slow routes and 5xx here page first.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `rpm` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE duration.ms < 500) AS `satisfied %` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.route` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 12

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS rpm, percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %`, percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.route` LIMIT 30
FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS spans WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'SERVER' FACET `http.status_code` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 12
FROM Span SELECT average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'CLIENT' FACET name TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 12

FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS calls, percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'CLIENT' FACET name LIMIT 20
FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS denials WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `http.status_code` IN ('401', '403') FACET `http.route` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS `auth errors` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND message LIKE '%auth%fail%' OR message LIKE '%NextAuth%' FACET `http.route` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Metric SELECT average(db_pool_wait_ms) AS `pool wait ms`, max(db_pool_used) AS `pool used` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT average(duration.ms) AS `db avg ms` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (name LIKE '%postgres%' OR `db.system` = 'postgresql') TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT average(process_runtime_nodejs_eventloop_lag_ms) AS `loop lag ms`, average(process_heap_used_bytes / 1000000) AS `heap MB` WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample WHERE service.name = 'web' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (level = 'error' OR severity = 'ERROR') FACET `http.route` LIMIT 20
